saw_lines: Tea buyers pick a blend once, then reorder it for months, so the first order is where the loyalty starts.
So the sale is won in the first line, where a stranger decides whether to trust the first order.
Your site shows 145 reviews and 40,000+ customers, yet none of your 30 live ads use either number. Lead your next batch with the 145 reviews on the creative.

ads.source: Meta Ad Library, active ads, 15 Oct 2026
points: The site shows 145 reviews and 40,000+ customers, yet none of your 30 live ads use either number. New buyers need that proof before they click. Put the 145 reviews on the creative and open two ads with a review quote.
Your site offers subscribe and save, yet none of your 14 fixed copy ads mention it. A new buyer has no reason to act today. Put subscribe and save in the first line of three new ads, on the creative.

Your site has a shipping page, but 0 of 30 live ads mention shipping or delivery. Buyers who cannot tell how their order arrives skip the click. Open new ads by answering that question, and show free shipping over $59.

Your site lists subscribe and save at 15%, yet 0 of 30 live ads mention a subscription. A monthly tea drinker never sees the saving. Run two retention ads with the subscription saving as the headline, aimed at past buyers.

ads_1: Review-led creative for tea buyers, with subscribe and save as the offer
